explanation: Raw candidate n of unit 21 sits saturated near 1; timing (a steep decline in the last episode deciles) explains R^2 0.66. Beyond timing, it dips at D1 after a1 reached S2 rarely (strongest if that trial was rewarded, -0.027), and at D2 when the previous trial was unrewarded, especially when that trial reached S1, with the dip much larger in the last episode decile and after two unrewarded trials in a row. Late in the episode a reward shown at D1 also lowers it. Belief, the current choice/state and hidden good state add little. The free fit (8 terms, no future vars) reaches about 0.16 dev versus an observed-cue ceiling of 0.22 (all 0.25); the residual is mostly late-episode amplitude that additive indicators miss. The short form keeps the three largest effects.
